newsitem.title: USA: Universal Electronics to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Universal Electronics to buy back shares.

text.p: Universal Electronics Inc said on Thursday it planned to purchase up to one million shares of the company's common stock.
The company said the purchases may be made from time to time, in the open market or in private transactions, depending on price among other factors.
The company has about 6.8 million shares outstanding.

David M. Gabrielsen, chairman, president and chief executive, said, "The long-term outlook for Universal Electronics remains very positive. ... By purchasing our stock, we are recognizing the outstanding opportunities presented to the company and the long-term investment value of our common stock."
